facts.activity_file: handing back a partially completed isolation

control_failures.control_label: identification of every energy source for the task
controlled removal of isolation and return to service
parking, chocking and restraint of equipment

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: stored energy found after isolation of P-9504

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 4 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control ENERGY_SOURCE_IDENTIFICATION: the identification of every energy source for the task was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control ISOLATION_HANDBACK_CONTROL: the controlled removal of isolation and return to service had been bypassed, and the root cause analysis classified this as an individual or team action.
Control PARK_UP_AND_RESTRAINT: the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next field verification that the identification of every energy source for the task on P-9504 and PT-9504 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in restoring plant to service, specifically handing back a partially completed isolation. P-9504 (dewatering pumps) is in service for pit dewatering. The task proceeded during commissioning of replacement equipment while the identification of every energy source for the task was not in place. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 16 January 2012 a hazard report was recorded on P-9504 and PT-9504 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during commissioning of replacement equipment; kinetic energy held as rotating equipment was not released.
